metrics.outcome_header: isotropic noise increase; no aging claim beyond stiffness

deviations: substate_alignment is NaN for every type because the Census observations contain no annotation below cell_type; per the binding A03 clarification, no substate clustering was derived.

Standalone fits were summarized only with axis-free per-age quantities. Isotropy and anticipation were intentionally not calculated across standalone coordinate systems, as required by the binding shared-space clarification.
No frozen parameter, seed, test, hardware, or compute-budget deviation occurred.
observations: All eight eligible types were retained for the frozen pooled outcome and none met the correction_artifact condition.
Three of six marrow types passed isotropy, but 3/6 is not a strict majority; both lung types failed isotropy and anticipation.
Promonocyte was the only anticipation pass (1/8 pooled), with cos_abs_u_young_d 0.470313 above its 0.462915 null q95.
Silhouette selected two descriptive aging modes: granulocytopoietic cell formed one mode and the remaining seven types the other; both received the descriptive label mixed.
suggestions: If authorized as exploratory, assess the pre-proposed basin-only subset because five marrow types have shared holder fractions below 0.5, while the frozen outcome correctly retained all eight eligible types.

If authorized as exploratory, quantify donor-level sensitivity or hierarchical uncertainty because young-donor replication remains limited (four lung donors and two marrow donors after A01 filtering).
